title: Belief Updating without Complete Trust
abstract: arXiv:2609.04622v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We represent a non-Bayesian agent as one who does not completely trust the information they receive. The behavioral expression of complete trust lies in a homogeneity property of Bayesian updating: posterior beliefs do not change if a signal is made arbitrarily rare by scaling down its likelihood vector. We show that simply dropping this property and retaining all other Bayesian behavioral properties yields a unique representation where the agent is still Bayesian but has subjective uncertainty over the information structure generating the signal. The representation result is proved using the Fundamental Theorem of Projective Geometry. We analyze how various updating biases may be rationalized by a lack of trust.

translated_title: 没有完全信任的信念更新
translated_abstract: 我们将非贝叶斯代理人刻画为不完全信任其所接收信息的主体。完全信任的行为表达体现在贝叶斯更新的一种同质性属性上：如果通过缩小信号的可能性向量使某个信号变得任意罕见，后验信念不会随之改变。我们证明，只需去掉这一同质性属性并保留所有其他贝叶斯行为性质，即可得到一个唯一的表示：代理人仍然是贝叶斯式的，但对生成信号的信息结构具有主观不确定性。该表示结果是利用射影几何基本定理证明的。我们分析了各种更新偏差如何可以通过信任缺失得到合理化。
tldr: 本文通过放弃贝叶斯更新中的同质性属性，证明不完全信任所接收信息的非贝叶斯代理人可以唯一地表示为对信息结构具有主观不确定性的贝叶斯代理人，该结果借助射影几何基本定理加以证明，并说明各类更新偏差可由信任缺失合理化。
en_tdlr: By dropping the homogeneity property of Bayesian updating, this paper shows that a non-Bayesian agent who incompletely trusts received information is uniquely represented as a Bayesian agent with subjective uncertainty over the information structure, a result proved via the Fundamental Theorem of Projective Geometry that rationalizes various updating biases.
